senses.gloss: = exedra (v. אַכְסַדְרָא), recess in the house, sitting room in the shape of an open hall, generally supported by columns.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 7a:8">B. Bath. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>חד מטייה א׳</he> one of the heirs received a hall as his share.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 7a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>קא בני … דא׳</he> the other built a wall in front of the hall (debarring light and air).
Esth. R. to I, 9 בית א׳ reception rooms.— Pl. אִסְפְּלִידֵי.
<cite ref="Menachot 33b:10">Men. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דאית להו וכ׳</he> halls supported by columns.
